request.query: finite set polynomials prescribed monomial support coefficients in finite sets

items.name: MvPolynomial.support
items.type: {R : Type u} → {σ : Type u_1} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial σ R → Finset (σ →₀ ℕ)

items.name: Polynomial.coeffs
items.type: {R : Type u} → [inst : Semiring R] → Polynomial R → Finset R

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeffs
items.type: {R : Type u} → {σ : Type u_1} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial σ R → Finset R

items.name: MvPolynomial.as_sum
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  p = ∑ v ∈ p.support, (MvPolynomial.monomial v) (MvPolynomial.coeff v p)

items.name: FirstOrder.Ring.mvPolynomialSupportLEEquiv
items.type:
{ι : Type u_1} →
  {κ : Type u_2} →
    {R : Type u_3} →
      [DecidableEq κ] →
        [inst : CommRing R] →
          [DecidableEq R] →
            (monoms : ι → Finset (κ →₀ ℕ)) → { p // ∀ (i : ι), (p i).support ⊆ monoms i } ≃ ((i : ι) × ↥(monoms i) → R)

items.name: MvPolynomial.mem_coeffs_iff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {c : R},
  c ∈ p.coeffs ↔ ∃ n ∈ p.support, c = MvPolynomial.coeff n p
